title: Docking and autonomous passage signals

specimens.name: Split closure witness
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. Two short mating optical tips in direct butt contact forming one flush uninterrupted output edge, distinct seam visible. No emitter shoe.

specimens.name: Angular sector indicator
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. Single triangular aperture with vertical opaque louvers restricting viewing angle. No chevron.

specimens.name: Passive retroreflective marker
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One passive wedge block with a SQUARE exposed front face, seen nearly head-on; wedge taper is behind the square face and visible on right side only. On the square face show a complete THREE BY THREE array: three whole cavities across, three whole cavities down, exactly NINE uncropped corner-cube cavities. Each cavity is a deep trihedral concave reflector with three planar faces and one deep vertex. Clear dark dividers. No triangular outer frame, missing cells, emitter or lettering.

specimens.name: Bidirectional signal splitter
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. Short gabled optic with two opposed output faces separated by one opaque crest.

specimens.name: Latch travel optical window
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One lock witness in three-quarter cutaway. Show dark stepped slider and its single deep notch directly aligned with a narrow rectangular window in front plate; cut off top corner of plate so both notch and window edges are visible, with one straight unobstructed opening through them. No blank lens or pivot.

specimens.name: Fan warning optic
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. One low curved lens segment with clearly radiating ribs for horizontal pulse distribution. No flash.

specimens.name: Guard status light guide
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. One hard guide turning around a short guard edge with two offset outlets on different planes, retaining shoulder engaged.

specimens.name: Passive clearance flag
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Open oblique cutaway of short dark pocket containing one half-disc flag in stowed state. Its straight opaque matte chord is flush with pocket opening. Behind chord, show the reflective semicircular rim entirely BELOW the pocket rim through a side cutaway. Show single pivot at one end of chord. Nothing curved protrudes above pocket.
